correctness.rationale: The verifier reconstructs the exact 24-facet surface, checks H1 over F2 has dimension 5, exhausts all simple cycles of lengths 3 through 6 until all 31 nonzero classes are reached, enumerates all 9! vertex permutations to obtain the automorphism orbits, and checks the integral half-boundary torsion representative. The published integral H1=Z^4 plus Z/2 then identifies that nonzero 2-torsion cycle as the unique torsion generator.

value.rationale: The result completely classifies the intrinsic simple-cycle length of every nonzero mod-two first-homology class on a canonical vertex-minimal neighborly genus-five surface. The unique extremal class is not a coordinate artifact: it is the reduction of the canonical order-two Bockstein class, and it is simultaneously the only automorphism-fixed nonzero class. This connects nonorientability, combinatorial systolic length, and symmetry in a reusable exact invariant.
